title: WOW4 – World Of Women Kizomba Weekender 2026
description:
World of Women Weekender- A Unique Experience 💞
“An event for women, by women – with the goal of community building”
📅4th-6th December 2026
📍In Lyon, France for the first time
🎟Tickets available right now!
—
👑What is WOW?
🌟 WOW is a women-only weekend event designed to empower and develop female dance skills
🌟 Offers tailor-made workshops to develop all aspects of your dance
🌟 A safe and powerful space for women to connect and exchange with new friends
🌟A movement in support of female artists in the kizomba scene
